As "[[Flash Strike]]" shows RA-7-81 to be an RA-7 [[Protocol droid|droid]], it must therefore also have been manufactured by Arakyd. |line= |model=[[RA-7 protocol droid]]{{TBB|Flash Strike}} |class=[[Protocol droid]] |cost= |length= |width= |height=1.68 [[meter]]s{{Databank|ra-7-81|RA-7-81}} |mass= |gender= |pronouns=It/its{{TBB|Flash Strike}} {{AD|Disney+}} |sensor=[[Color|Black]] |plating=Gray |armament= |equipment= |affiliation=[[Galactic Empire]] }} {{Quote|Wait. You are not authorized to be here. This area is under my jurisdiction.''"
"''Ah, well, I was, uh, checking the manifest.''"
"''What is going on here?|RA-7-81 and Echo|audio=RA-7-81-TBB-FlashStrike.flac|}} '''RA-7-81''' was an [[RA-7 protocol droid]] who was stationed on board one of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[science vessel]]s. After the [[Starship|vessel]] journeyed from [[Imperial Station 003]] above the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] to [[Tantiss Base]] on the planet [[Wayland]] during or after [[18 BBY]], RA-7-81 discovered the stowaway [[Cloning|clone]] [[Echo]] in the vessel's cargo hold disguised as a [[TK stormtrooper]]. When the [[protocol droid]] was not convinced by Echo's claim that he had been checking the manifest, the clone shot and [[Death|destroyed]] the [[droid]], taking its hand to hide his [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] [[scomp link]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Thanks for the hand.|Echo steals RA-7-81's hand|audio=Echo-Hand-TBB-FlashStrike.flac|}} [[File:RA-7-81Echo-TBB-FlashStrike.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Echo, disguised as a TK stormtrooper, looks back over his shoulder at a surprised RA-7-81 in a room of cargo on the science vessel.|RA-7-81 discovered a disguised Echo on the science vessel.]] RA-7-81 was an [[RA-7 protocol droid]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries]] that served the [[Galactic Empire]]. During or after [[18 BBY]], it was stationed on board a [[science vessel]] [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[Lieutenant]] [[Novitz]] that was traveling from [[Imperial Station 003]] in [[orbit]] of{{TBB|Into the Breach}} the [[planet]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant}} [[Coruscant]] to [[Tantiss Base]], a secret Imperial facility on the planet [[Wayland]]. Unbeknownst to the vessel's crew, the [[Cloning|clone]] [[cyborg]] [[Echo]] had snuck on board at the [[Space station|orbital station]] and was hiding in the vessel's cargo hold, an area over which RA-7-81 held jurisdiction. While the ship traveled through [[hyperspace]], Echo looked at the vessel's [[Cargo manifest|manifest]] on a [[viewscreen]] until he heard RA-7-81's footsteps approaching. The clone then hid as the [[Protocol droid|droid]] entered the cargo hold and checked the same screen Echo had been looking at. After the science vessel reached Wayland, Echo was once again alone in the cargo hold and disguised himself as a [[TK stormtrooper]]. The vessel then landed at Tantiss Base and was boarded by TK [[stormtrooper]]s searching for any stowaways. [[File:RA-7-81Shot-TBB-FlashStrike.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A red blaster bolt strikes RA-7-81 in the chest as the droid raises its hands in surrender.|RA-7-81 was shot by Echo.]] Passing some of the searching [[trooper]]s in a corridor, RA-7-81 returned to the cargo hold. Hearing the [[droid]] approach, Echo began to leave but was spotted by RA-7-81, who called for him to stop and stated that he lacked authorization to be in the hold. Echo claimed to have been checking the manifest, but when RA-7-81 was unconvinced, the clone shot the droid in the chest with his [[DC-15A blaster carbine|blaster]], [[Death|destroying]] it. Echo then took the droid's right [[Limb|hand]] in order to hide the [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] [[scomp link]] he had in place of his own hand and escaped the vessel. ==Characteristics== RA-7-81 had [[Color|gray]] plating and black [[sensor]]s. It stood 1.68 [[meter]]s tall. ==Behind the scenes== RA-7-81 was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]] in "[[Flash Strike]]," the fourteenth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[April 24]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} The character's name was not spoken in the episode but was listed in the episode's credits. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of RA-7-81|imagecat=Images of RA-7-81}} *{{TBB|Flash Strike}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|The Cavalry Has Arrived}} {{C|Hand only}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/flash-strike-episode-guide|text="Flash Strike" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} *{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-flash-strike|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Flash Strike"}} *{{Databank|ra-7-81|RA-7-81}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=RA-7-81 |fr=RA-7-81 |ja=RA-7-81 |ka=RA-7-81 |nl=RA-7-81 }} [[Category:Droids of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Droids with it/its pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:RA-7 protocol droids]]
